title: Netanyahu posts video in response to online rumours that he is dead
byline: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu posted a video of himself getting a cup of coffee and chatting with his aide on Sunday, after rumours that he was dead or injured ‌were aired by Iranian state media and spread online in Iran.

title: Trump says he expects China to help secure Strait of Hormuz
byline: Following his comments on Nato, Donald Trump also spoke to the Financial Times about his upcoming summit in Beijing with China’s President Xi Jinping.

title: Fire breaks out in vicinity of Dubai International Airport after drone attack, Dubai Media Office says
byline: The Dubai Media Office said on Monday that authorities were dealing with a fire resulting from a drone attack in the vicinity of the Dubai International Airport, adding that no injuries were reported.

title: Showers expected in parts of the island today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, North-western and Uva provinces after 2.00 pm, today (15), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Multi-day fishing trawler with suspected narcotics to be brought to Dikkowita Harbour
byline: The multi-day fishing trawler seized by the Sri Lanka Navy while transporting several sacks suspected to contain narcotics in seas south of Dondra is currently being brought ashore to the Dikkowita Fisheries Harbour.

title: Fire contained in vicinity of Dubai airport after drone attack, flights suspended
byline: The Dubai Media Office said on Monday that authorities were dealing with a fire resulting from a drone attack in the vicinity of the Dubai International Airport, adding that no injuries were reported.

title: ‘One Battle After Another’ wins six Oscars, including best picture
byline: Paul Thomas Anderson’s darkly comic action thriller One Battle After Another has claimed the Academy Award for Best Picture, capping a dominant night that saw the film secure six Oscars in total.

title: Multi-day fishing trawler with suspected narcotics brought to Dikkowita Harbour
byline: The multi-day fishing trawler seized by the Sri Lanka Navy while transporting several sacks suspected to contain narcotics in seas south of Dondra is currently being brought ashore to the Dikkowita Fisheries Harbour.

title: ‘Unacceptable attacks’: French President Macron urges Iran to halt strikes after call with Iranian President Pezeshkian
byline: French President Emmanuel Macron said he urged Iran to end attacks across the Middle East and called for restoring freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz during a phone call with Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian.

title: 123kg of heroin worth over Rs. 3 billion found on seized fishing trawler off Dondra
byline: Approximately 123 kilograms of heroin have been found aboard the multi-day fishing trawler seized by the Sri Lanka Navy in seas south of Dondra, according to Deputy Minister of Defence Aruna Jayasekara.

title: Oscars 2026: Winners list in full
byline: Hollywood’s best and brightest have been honoured with the most coveted awards in the movie industry, the Oscars.

title: Two suspects arrested with ‘Ice’ and heroin in Kotadeniyawa and Ahungalla
byline: An individual has been arrested in Kotadeniyawa for the possession of narcotic substances heroin and Crystal Methamphetamine (‘Ice’).

title: Kpop Demon Hunters wins Oscars for best original song and best animated film
byline: Kpop Demon Hunters, the viral movie about supernatural K-pop stars, has won Oscars for best animated feature film and best original song.

title: Trump says that he’s asked ‘about 7’ countries to join coalition to police Iran’s Strait of Hormuz
byline: President Donald Trump said Sunday that he has demanded about seven countries send warships to keep the Strait of Hormuz open, but his appeals have brought no commitments as oil prices soar during the Iran war.

title: Michael B. Jordan wins best actor Oscar for dual role in ‘Sinners’
byline: First-time nominee Michael B. Jordan won the best actor Oscar on Sunday for playing twin brothers in the genre-bending vampire tale ‘‘Sinners."

title: Bribery Commission files indictments against ex-MP Sajin Vass Gunawardena
byline: Indictments were filed before the Colombo High Court today (16) against former Member of Parliament Sajin Vass Gunawardena over allegations of corruption.

title: CPC confirms arrival of new fuel tanker, warns public about fraudulent QR code websites
byline: The Managing Director of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), Mayura Neththikumara stated that a fuel tanker arrived in Sri Lanka this morning (16), and arrangements have been made to commence unloading of its cargo within the day.

title: Dubai airport resumes some flights after drone attack spotlights risks
byline: Dubai’s international airport was gradually resuming flights on Monday, authorities said, after a fire caused by a drone attack forced a temporary suspension, further disrupting traffic in one of the world’s busiest air travel hubs.

title: At least 10 patients killed in hospital fire in India’s Odisha
byline: At least 10 people were killed in a fire that broke out in the trauma care unit of a hospital in the eastern Indian state of Odisha on Monday, officials said.

title: Brent crude trades near $105 as Iran attacks more Gulf targets, while shares are mixed
byline: Brent crude oil traded near $105 per barrel on Monday as Gulf countries reported more attacks by Iran with the war entering its third week, while share prices were mixed.

title: Sri Lanka Tourism Alliance unveils ‘Love Sri Lanka, Always’ campaign
byline: The Sri Lanka Tourism Alliance has launched its new tactical campaign burst, “Love Sri Lanka, Always,” an evocative global initiative designed to reposition the island as a destination to discover and rediscover throughout the year across select international markets.

title: Final agreement reached on unified ‘Avurudu Nekath Seettuwa’– Minister
byline: The Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious, and Cultural Affairs, Dr. Hiniduma Sunil Senevi, stated that both parties have reached an agreement to publish a unified set of auspicious times (“Avurudu Nekath Seettuwa”) for this year’s Sinhala and Tamil New Year.

title: “Mastermind behind Easter attack will be revealed on March 31” - claims Gammanpila
byline: The leader of the Pivithuru Hela Urumaya (PHU), former Member of Parliament Udaya Gammanpila, stated that his party is ready to reveal the mastermind behind the Easter attacks to the country on March 31, 2026.

title: Govt should lower fuel taxes to stabilize prices - Former CPC Chairman
byline: The former Chairman of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), Mohamed Uvais, stated that the government should consider reducing taxes imposed on fuel in order to maintain price stability as much as possible.

title: Case against Hirunika Premachandra and 14 others to be recalled in August
byline: The Colombo Magistrate’s Court today (16) ordered that the complaint filed against former Member of Parliament Hirunika Premachandra and 14 others, over allegations that the suspects caused public inconvenience, be taken up again on August 17, 2026.

title: Vehicle importers raise concerns over QR code–based fuel quota system
byline: President of the Vehicle Importers’ Association of Sri Lanka (VIASL), Prasad Manage, says that vehicle importers have encountered difficulties due to the QR code–based fuel quota system introduced by the government for fuel distribution.

title: China calls for immediate cease to military operations, after Trump’s comments
byline: China has responded after President Trump earlier, in an interview with UK newspaper the Financial Times, threatened to delay a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping if Beijing doesn’t send help to secure the Strait of Hormuz.

title: School events should not place financial burden on parents – PM Harini
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated that school events should be organized in a manner that does not place a financial burden on parents.

title: Farmers to receive fuel for harvesting and ploughing without QR code
byline: Farmers will be provided with 15 litres of fuel per acre for harvesting and 20 litres per acre for ploughing (land preparation) without the need for a QR code, according to the Commissioner General of the Department of Agrarian Development, Dhammika Ranatunga.

title: QR-based fuel quota system not necessary if public conserves fuel – Dy Minister
byline: The Deputy Minister of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development, Chathuranga Abeysinghe, stated that a QR code-based fuel quota system would not be necessary if the public uses fuel sparingly in light of the current crisis.

title: Only 50% of private buses will operate if fuel supplied through SLTB depots - LPBOA
byline: The President of the Lanka Private Bus Owners’ Association (LPBOA), Gemunu Wijeratne, stated that private passenger buses are currently facing numerous difficulties in obtaining fuel from depots belonging to the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB).

title: 133kg of heroin worth over Rs. 3 billion found on seized fishing trawler off Dondra
byline: Approximately 133 kilograms of heroin have been found aboard the multi-day fishing trawler seized by the Sri Lanka Navy in seas south of Dondra, according to Deputy Minister of Defence Aruna Jayasekara.

title: Russia fines Telegram app for failing to remove banned content
byline: Russia has fined the Telegram messaging app 35 million roubles ($432,366) for failing to remove banned content, Russia’s Interfax news agency reported on ⁠Monday.

title: Starmer says UK will not be drawn into wider Iran war
byline: Prime Minister Keir Starmer said Britain would not be drawn into a wider war in Iran but would work with allies including those in Europe to reopen the key Strait of Hormuz, although he acknowledged that it would not be easy.

title: Weekly fuel quota for passenger buses to be increased
byline: The Chairman of the National Transport Commission (NTC), P. A. Chandrapala, stated that arrangements are being made to provide a weekly fuel quota ranging from 60 to 360 litres for passenger transport buses.

title: Over 250kg of cocaine seized from fishing trawler intercepted off Beruwala
byline: The Sri Lanka Navy has revealed that the multi-day fishing trawler intercepted in the sea area off Beruwala and brought to the Dikkowita Harbour this evening (16) was discovered to be carrying over 250 kilograms of cocaine.

title: Wednesdays declared holiday for govt employees, schools & unis; private sector urged to do same
byline: The Government has decided to declare Wednesdays of every week as a holiday for government sector employees with effect from March 18, 2026, after taking into consideration the current fuel situation in Sri Lanka.

title: National Fuel Pass system disruptions to be fully resolved by tomorrow – Ministry
byline: The Ministry of Digital Economy has announced that the technical issues currently affecting the National Fuel Pass (NFP) system are being successfully resolved.

title: President leads high-level talks on energy management to safeguard economy and essential services
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake stated that, in light of the challenges arising from the prevailing conflict situation in the Middle East, plans are being implemented to manage energy resources effectively while ensuring the uninterrupted continuation of the country’s economic activities and essential services.

title: No fuel will be provided to those cutting the queues - Police
byline: The Deputy Inspector General (DIG) in charge of the Traffic and Road Safety Range, W.P.J. Senadheera, has stated that no individuals attempting to bypass the queues at fuel stations will be permitted to obtain fuel.
